name: ICRDeliveryStrategyCS
title: ICR Delivery Strategy
description: How a campaign activity reaches its target population. A first-class, coded attribute of every campaign activity, site, and task — campaigns routinely mix strategies, and the available data elements change with the strategy (working doc §3).

concept.definition: Delivery at a permanent health facility site; people come to the site.
Delivery at a temporary community focal point: market, place of worship, transit point.
Team deployed to remote areas for a few hours per site.
Delivery through schools to enrolled (and catch-up for non-enrolled) school-age children.
Teams systematically visit every dwelling (door-to-door); the only strategy that natively produces houses-visited, present/absent, and refusal data.
Community-selected drug distributors (CDDs) treat their own communities — the NTD MDA backbone (CDTI).

Vaccination at outside-household special-strategy sites (water points, transit/bus stations, border-crossing points, food-distribution points) — the polio SIA 'outside household / special strategy' (OHH/SS) mode, broader than a single temporary post (forms-v1 / jul3-form-analysis §Aggregate #6).
